standard.summary: PiD 是 pixel diffusion decoder，可在 VAE decode 位置把 latent 解码/放大成像素。Lulynx 只支持用户本地提供权重的原生后端契约。
standard.effect: 未来 decode_backend=pid 会替换普通 VAE decode；当前 preview/generation/postprocess 路由尚未注册。
standard.whenToUse: 用户已有合规 PiD 权重，并希望后续用于高质量解码或放大时。
standard.avoidWhen: 需要商用再分发、自动下载或捆绑官方权重；官方权重按 Anima 包装说明属于 NVIDIA NSCLv1 non-commercial。

standard_en.summary: PiD is a pixel diffusion decoder that can decode or upscale the latent where VAE decode sits. Lulynx only supports the native backend contract with weights the user provides locally.
standard_en.effect: In future decode_backend=pid will replace ordinary VAE decode; today the preview/generation/postprocess routes are not registered yet.
standard_en.whenToUse: When you already hold compliant PiD weights and want to use them later for high-quality decoding or upscaling.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When you need commercial redistribution, automatic download, or bundled official weights; per the Anima packaging notes the official weights are NVIDIA NSCLv1 non-commercial.

advanced.principle: 按 backbone 做 latent normalization，再用 PiD decoder 逐步输出像素结果。
advanced.intervention: Future decode backend selector → local checkpoint preflight → preview/generation/postprocess route。
advanced.expectedImpact: 可能改善解码质量和放大结果；训练时间无直接影响。
advanced.tradeoffs: 源码许可证和权重许可证分开处理；未确认权重授权前不能自动启用。

advanced_en.principle: Performs latent normalization per backbone, then the PiD decoder outputs pixel results step by step.
advanced_en.intervention: Future decode backend selector → local checkpoint preflight → preview/generation/postprocess route.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: May improve decode quality and upscale results; no direct effect on training time.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Source license and weight license are handled separately; it cannot be auto-enabled until weight licensing is confirmed.
